structured_summary.event: SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)— September 21, 2026-- Vistagen (Nasdaq: VTGN), a late clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company leveraging nose-to-brain neurocircuitry to develop and commercialize a new class of intranasal product candidates called pherines, today announced preliminary positive data from the open-label extension (OLE) portion of its PALISADE-4 Phase 3 study of fasedienol for the acute treatment of social anxiety disorder.
structured_summary.detail: 1 As previously reported, the Company believes its clinical program for fasedienol nasal spray for the acute treatment of social anxiety disorder has achieved the minimum patient exposures as recommended under ICH E1, the international regulatory standard governing safety database exposure recommendations for drugs intended for long-term treatment (chronic or repeated intermittent use for longer than 6 months) of non-life-threatening conditions.
